Expense reports must be submitted within thirty days of the end of travel. Reports submitted after this window require written approval from a department director before they can be reimbursed.

A direct manager approves expense reports up to 5,000 USD. Reports above 5,000 USD additionally require finance review. Reports above 25,000 USD require the CFO.

1. The business sponsor files Form VSR-204 and names the data
   involved.
2. The vendor risk team assigns a tier within two business
   days.
3. The vendor receives the security questionnaire for the
   assigned tier.
4. The security team reviews the returned questionnaire within
   five business days of receipt.
5. Where the questionnaire shows a gap, the vendor submits a
   written remediation plan with owners and dates before the review continues.
6. The security team verifies any remediation the plan calls
   complete.
7. For Tier 3 Restricted engagements the vendor also supplies
   a penetration test report no more than twelve months old.
8. The vendor risk team records a decision of approved,
   approved with conditions, or declined.
9. Conditions are tracked by the business sponsor until they
   are closed.
10. The decision and its evidence are filed against the
    contract.

[6] (vendor-security-review.pdf, p.1)
# Starting a review

A review is started by filing Form VSR-204 with the vendor risk team. The form must name a business sponsor and the data the vendor will touch. Reviews are started at least thirty business days before the intended contract signature.

[7] (travel-policy.pdf, p.4)
# Air travel

Economy class is the default for all flights. Premium economy is permitted for flights with a scheduled duration over eight hours. Business class requires CFO approval regardless of duration.

5. Where the questionnaire shows a gap, the vendor submits a
   written remediation plan with owners and dates before the review continues.
6. The security team verifies any remediation the plan calls
   complete.
7. For Tier 3 Restricted engagements the vendor also supplies
   a penetration test report no more than twelve months old.
8. The vendor risk team records a decision of approved,
   approved with conditions, or declined.
9. Conditions are tracked by the business sponsor until they
   are closed.
10. The decision and its evidence are filed against the
    contract.

# Starting a review

A review is started by filing Form VSR-204 with the vendor risk team. The form must name a business sponsor and the data the vendor will touch. Reviews are started at least thirty business days before the intended contract signature.

[3] (vendor-security-review.pdf, p.4)
# Reassessment

An approved vendor is reassessed annually. A reassessment is also triggered before that date by a material change: a new data tier, a sub-processor the vendor had not declared, or a reported breach affecting the vendor.

[4] (engineering-runbook.pdf, p.2)
# Rolling back a release

Roll back to the previous known-good revision with the platform CLI. The command is idempotent.

```bash
# roll back the api service to the prior revision
acmectl rollback --service api --to previous \
    --cluster prod-eu --confirm
```

A rollback does NOT revert database migrations. Reverting a migration is a separate, manual change.
